context: Directions Do not exceed more than 6 doses in any 24-hour period Adults and children 12 years of age and over Take 1 teaspoonful (5 mL) every 4 hours Children 6 to under 12 years of age Take 1/2 teaspoonful (2.5 mL) every 4 hours Children under 6 years of age Ask a doctor
